t: Greetings to Maria Mikhailova and Anzhela Bladtseva, winners of the 2026 World Trampoline Championships in Nanjing, China
d: Vladimir Putin congratulated Maria Mikhailova and Anzhela Bladtseva on their victory in the synchronised trampoline event at the 2026 World Trampoline Gymnastics Championships in Nanjing, China.

t: Congratulations to Dmitry Nartov and Kirill Panteleyev on their victory at the 2026 World Trampoline Championships in Nanjing
d: Vladimir Putin sent greetings to Dmitry Nartov and Kirill Panteleyev to congratulate them on winning the synchronised event at the 2026 World Trampoline Gymnastics Championships in Nanjing.

t: Congratulations to Russia’s national team on winning the team all-around event at the 2026 World Trampoline Championships in Nanjing
d: Vladimir Putin congratulated the Russian national team on winning the team all-around event and taking first place in the unofficial team standings at the 2026 Trampoline World Championships in Nanjing.
